description: An expander carrying pitch and level control voltages for Flick, and it goes immediately to the LEFT of the Flick it belongs to

inputs.text: Shifts the pitch of that half of Flick at one volt per octave, multiplying the decay rate set by Flick's own tone knob
Scales the level of that half of Flick's output; 10V passes it at full, 0V silences it, and with nothing patched the jack reads 10V

notes: This module has no sound of its own and does nothing unless a Flick is placed immediately to its right; Flick reads these four jacks out of its left expander

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 10V.
inputs.2:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 10V.
